artifacts.summary: Finds the dispatch's premise stale (ROADMAP.md rewritten three times since task creation; scripts/roadmap-integration.sh is dead/quarantined, not a live two-mode script); maps the actually-reusable generate-task-order.sh machinery (compute_waves, generate_wave_table, read_existing_goal, --print as the only consumption path); flags three roadmap 'belongs with 306' observations that actually collide with concurrent siblings 271/272's file_scope; and recommends grounding the new roadmap-format.md generation contract in the measured current file shape with an explicit authored-vs-generated section split.

memory_candidates.content: generate-task-order.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/) is a top-level script with no function-sourcing boundary -- build_graph/compute_waves/generate_wave_table run unconditionally at file scope. A downstream consumer that wants its wave/topic data cannot `source` the file to call its functions directly; it must invoke `generate-task-order.sh --print` as a subprocess and parse stdout. Relevant to any future script that needs the dependency-wave or topic-grouping data this script computes.

When a task's file_scope or dispatch description names a script path under agent-system/extensions/*/scripts/ that cannot be found there, check scripts/deprecated/ before assuming the path is wrong or the task description is simply mistaken -- the house convention (QUARANTINE-NEVER-DELETE, scripts/deprecated/README.md) is to move a zero-live-caller script there rather than delete it, and task descriptions written before a quarantine can go stale without any signal.

specs/ROADMAP.md has been rewritten into a structurally different shape at least three times in recent history (per-call markdown tables -> ## Call N headers -> ## Open work category blocks), and context/formats/roadmap-format.md's existing spec matches none of the three. A task description or dispatch file that cites ROADMAP.md's 'current' field names or structure should be treated as a snapshot that may already be stale by dispatch time; re-measure the live file directly rather than trusting the description's field-name list verbatim.
